M60. 1, J.Chandler (Wav) 39:54; 2, L.Forster (Barnet) 40:08; 3, C.Walker (Belgrave) 41:32. BVAF NATIONAL CC CHAMPS, CARDIFF, 15 MAR 1992

The M60 race was won by Jim Chandler of Waverley but close behind there was a right ding dong between the three Belgrave runners. Eventually a rather out of sorts Charlie Walker was dropped by the in form Bert Stroud, with Pat Newell tucked in behind.

He seems to enjoy this course, repeating his 1992 silver behind Jim Chandler of Waverley. Neither Charlie Walker or Bert Stroud were in the best of form but stuck it out and the team were just strong enough to take first place from Epsom and Ewell.
